texts.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的民用飞船到达了我们的国境，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesName]难民。他们被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些不幸的流放者被[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国强迫赶走出了自己的家园。自那之后，他们便四处流浪，孤注一掷地想要在物资耗尽前找到新的家园。
texts.en:
A flotilla of civilian transports carrying [Root.GetSpeciesName] refugees from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. They have been allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These unfortunate outcasts were forcefully expelled from their homes by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities. They have been traveling from system to system since then, in a desperate attempt to find new homes before the last of their dwindling supplies were used up.

texts.zh:
一小队来自[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的破败民用飞船到达了我们的领域，其中载满了[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]难民。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些狼狈恐慌的难民是逃离[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]帝国肃清的幸存者。多亏了一些紧急召集起来的地面下的一伙和同情他们的商船舰长才逃了出来。
texts.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are survivors from the extermination program being carried out by the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] authorities against their species. They only made it out thanks to the efforts of a hastily organized underground railroad and a few sympathetic merchant skippers.

texts.zh:
一支的破败民船舰队，满载着逃离[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，已经抵达了我们的境内。在我们提供了食物和医疗后，这些难民被准许在[Root.Planet.GetName]安家。

这些狼狈恐慌的难民是[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj]无情攻势下的幸存者。多亏他们冒险从星球上一处旧军港里偷了几艘废弃太空船才逃了出来。
texts.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are survivors of onslaught carried out by the merciless [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesAdj] mind. They only made it out thanks to a daring theft of several decommissioned spacefaring vessels stored in an old naval yard on their planet.

texts.zh:
一支伤痕累累的民用小舰队搭载着躲避[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName]的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，刚刚抵达了我们的星系。在我们提供食物与医疗救援之后，避难者们获准在[Root.Planet.GetName]上安家。

这些衣衫褴褛而且惊慌不已的避难者们正在躲避[RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName]星系内的[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName]的蹂躏。他们勉强在[RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj]的攻势抵达其母星[RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName]之前仓皇逃了出来，将大部分个人财物都留在了那颗注定要覆灭的星球上。
texts.en:
A battered fleet of small civilian vessels carrying [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] fleeing from the [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetName] have arrived in our space. After we supplied them with food and provided medical attention to their wounded, the refugees were allowed to settle on [Root.Planet.GetName].

These ragged and frightened refugees are fleeing the ravages of the [RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetName] in [RefugeeEscapedFrom.GetSpeciesName] space. They just barely managed to escape their home planet of [RefugeeEscapedPlanet.GetName] before the [RefugeeEscapedCrisis.GetSpeciesAdj] onslaught reached it, leaving most of their personal possessions behind on the doomed world.

notes.zh: 仅当接收国尚无同物种、同来源国的难民旗标（refugeespecies@/refugeecountry@）时才出现；否则改发隐藏的 refugees.2，只显示一条消息，且同一物种4个月内不再提示。
notes.en: Shown only when the receiving empire has no refugee flags for the same species and origin country (refugeespecies@ / refugeecountry@); otherwise hidden refugees.2 is used, which only sends a message and suppresses the same species for 4 months.

summary.text:
# [Root.GetSpeciesName]难民抵达 / [Root.GetSpeciesName] Refugees Arrive

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / C8 Galactic miscellany · 来源 Sources：`events/refugee_events.txt:10-258`、`common/scripted_effects/refugee_effects.txt:1-130,236-262`、`common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2176,3326` · 审阅 Reviewed 2026-10-13

## 如何开始 How it starts

有两条路径进入同一个窗口 refugees.1：(1) 人口被迫迁出（on_pop_displaced，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3326）→ 隐藏 refugees.3 → refugees.4；(2) 危机方轰炸行星（on_planet_bombarded，common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2176）→ 隐藏 refugees.5 → 45–90天后 refugees.6（需全局 galactic_crisis_happened、行星受危机轰炸、归属国是普通国家）。两者都调用 refugee_pop_effect。

Two paths lead to the same window refugees.1: (1) a pop is displaced (on_pop_displaced, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:3326) -> hidden refugees.3 -> refugees.4; (2) a crisis faction bombards a planet (on_planet_bombarded, common/on_actions/00_on_actions.txt:2176) -> hidden refugees.5 -> 45-90 days later refugees.6 (needs the global galactic_crisis_happened flag, a planet under crisis bombardment and a normal-empire owner). Both call refugee_pop_effect.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

refugee_pop_effect（refugee_effects.txt:1-130）：65%：若有物种创始国等适宜国家，难民回到故乡国家（宜居度0.7、有住房）；35%：按适宜度和住房依次尝试（0.7+住房 → 0.7 → 0.5+住房 → 0.5 → 0.2+住房 → 0.2 → 仅住房 → 任意可居），从候选国家中按“难民吸引力”加权随机挑一个。被选中的国家在随机一颗合适星球上安置人口，并收到 refugees.1“难民抵达”（该物种与来源国的组合是新的）或隐藏的 refugees.2（组合已出现过，只发消息）。窗口唯一选项“欢迎他们”，且在难民来源非危机阵营时对来源国情报+10。

refugee_pop_effect (refugee_effects.txt:1-130): 65%: if a suitable empire of the species' origin exists, the refugees go home (habitability 0.7 plus housing); 35%: tries in turn by habitability and housing (0.7+housing, 0.7, 0.5+housing, 0.5, 0.2+housing, 0.2, housing only, any habitability), picking from candidates weighted by refugee attraction. The chosen empire settles the pop on a random suitable planet and receives refugees.1 "Refugees Arrive" (this species/origin pairing is new) or hidden refugees.2 (pairing already seen; message only). The only option, They are welcome here, adds 10 intel on the origin empire unless it is a crisis faction.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

正文有四种：普通、被清洗（普通国家 / 格式塔国家）、被危机轰炸；无分支选项。

Four body versions: ordinary, purged (non-gestalt / gestalt origin), and crisis bombardment; no branching options.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

接收国需对该物种有至少0.2宜居度的星球。编译器在入口上显示的 p=0.65 只是“返回故乡”这一支的概率（65/100），另外35%的各档位同样汇入这个窗口，并非该窗口只有65%出现。

The receiving empire needs planets with at least 0.2 habitability for the species. The compiler's entry p=0.65 is only the "go home" branch (65/100); the 35% tiers lead to the same window, so the window is not limited to 65%.
